info.album: New York City Cops (Live In Iceland)

podcast.body: Due to the sensitive post-9/11 context, the release of *Is This It* had to be halted, and the song "New York City Cops" was replaced. In the United States, the CD version and the original vinyl release substituted this track with "When It Started." "acabaría reemplazando esa canción por buen instarte."

podcast.body: This song was originally featured as the fourth track on Side B of *Is This It*. Its lyrics contained choruses stating that New York police officers were "not excessively intelligent," which proved to be an unfortunate sentiment for a country that had just experienced the 9/11 attacks. "En esa canción decían en los coros que los policías de New York no eran excesivamente inteligentes."

podcast.body: This track was originally featured on "Is This It." However, for the album's US release in October 2001, it was replaced with "When It Started." This decision was made because the release date was too close to 9/11, and a song critical of first responders was deemed inappropriate. "The album featured a track called New York City Cops. But, October 2001 was too close to 9-11 to release a song critical of any first responders."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: While removed from early US releases, "New York City Cops" was included in later vinyl versions of *Is This It* in the United States. Moreover, it was consistently featured in versions released in Europe, Japan, and other international markets. "nosotros en Europa, en Japón y en Pratín, en todos países de los mundos, si tenemos la canción de New York City Cox."
